desc:
🐾 Welcome to Pet Store Tycoon! 🏢✨

💖 Feed, walk, and play with adorable animals! 🐶🐱 Build your dream pet store, unlock new floors, and expand your business to care for even more cute pets! Can you create the ultimate pet paradise? 😎💥

✨ Features:

🔓 Unlock new animals and expand your store!
🗺️ Visit the Vet and Food Store on the map!
🤝 Team up with friends to earn more money! 💰
🔓 Premium Benefit: Claim a free reward every 10 minutes! 💎

👍 200k Likes Goal for new updates!
⭐ 2M Favorites Goal to unlock special in-game rewards! 🎁✨

Tags: Pet Store, Business, Animal, Tycoon, Simulator, Daycare, Family, Adventure, Roleplay.

📌 Like 👍 & Favorite ⭐ the game to show your support and help us reach our goals! 😊💖
